_comment: Stormwood Surge and lightning cue contract, from docs/design/AUDIO.md §4.3 (phase table), §9 (captions: bracketed, lower case, a direction wedge when spatial) and §12.1 (every required event fires once from the correct owner; no stale audio survives realm teardown). Read by scripts/world/stormwood_surge_audio.gd. Every asset path below is the INTENDED location under the proposed assets/audio/stormwood/ directory: none of these files exists yet, and none may be generated, synthesized or copied in as a placeholder. The observer plays a cue only when ResourceLoader.exists(asset) is true, so the realm is silent for these cues today and plays them automatically once real assets land. Owners: phase beds are each peer's own presentation of the replicated Surge clock (stormwood_surge.gd presentation_key(), at the local trainer's region); the strike chain is host-owned and heard by every peer only through Session.stormwood_strike_received (the replicated lightning event: the host emits it locally, a client receives it by RPC), so each strike cue fires once per peer.

calm.caption: [steady rain in the Stormwood]
calm.spec_row: §4.3 Calm, 240 s baseline: rain/drip and low moss/forest life; distant thunder with long spacing

building.caption: [lightning building]
building.spec_row: §4.3 Building, 90 s: copper-vine ticks, increasing canopy motion and rising electrical bed; birds/insects fall away; no strike yet

break.caption: [the storm breaks]
break.spec_row: §4.3 Break, 120 s: the Break bed under the strike chain; rhythm follows the authored 4-8 s strike spacing

fading.caption: [thunder rolling away]
fading.spec_row: §4.3 Fading, 60 s: strike density stops; steam, glass and low rolling thunder decay; charged nodes/afterglow remain audible locally

release_cue.caption: [the storm lifts; ordinary forest sounds]
release_cue.trigger: stormwood:long_storm_ended set while the realm is live, or already set on realm entry
release_cue.replaces: every Surge phase bed; aftermath phase changes do not restart a Surge bed
release_cue.spec_row: §4.3 Stormheart release: removes the oppressive rod-line bed and opens ordinary forest/sky sound; it does not leave the same loop under brighter lighting

strike_chain._comment: One host strike = one warning event then one impact event with the same id, both carried by the replicated lightning event. The warning is spatial, at the strike's ground position, strike.telegraph_seconds (stormwood_surge.json, authored 1.2) before impact. strike/body/decay are three layers started together at the impact position; each asset carries its own length.

warning.caption: [lightning building, {direction}]
warning.spec_row: §4.3 Break: each strike uses a spatial 1.2 s warning whose direction and ground location are readable

caption_directions._comment: §9 direction wedge, relative to the local trainer's facing; 'nearby' inside near_m.

not_in_this_witness.rod_safe_area_density: §4.3: rod safe areas reduce warning density and electrical pressure rather than muting the forest. Density follows from the host lightning refusing sheltered ground (fewer warnings); a separate rod-area pressure layer is not wired here.
not_in_this_witness.stormglass_arches: §4.3: idle, relight, paired-ready, walk-through and blocked-in-combat cues. Not wired by this observer.
not_in_this_witness.dynamo: §4.3: bank, grounded-plate, overload, conduit-success and reset states. Not wired by this observer.
